important_boundary: Passing this research showcase gate is not production authorization; production deployment remains deny-by-default and requires independent review.

notes: The 15% data-quality ceiling is evaluated from AOI-scoped Sentinel SCL obscured pixels; scene-wide STAC cloud cover is only a candidate-ranking signal.
These gates prevent publishing a trivially non-functional model as a successful showcase.
Thresholds are research-showcase criteria, not claims of operational or regulatory fitness.
Production use requires independent labels, additional geography/season validation, security review and human scientific approval.
